description: Per-finding remediation drafts (spec 006, FR-011-FR-014). Writes a fix and a blast-radius note for one finding's own resource; applies nothing.

guardrail.note: Applied by the runtime as Converse's guardrailConfig, from the guardrail id and version infra sets in the environment. Principle II names guardrails as part of the GenAI layer.

tools.name: finding-read
tools.description: Read-only lookups for one finding, through the platform HTTP API. Every operation is a GET; the agent principal is refused on every other method (FR-056, R-602). Under AgentCore these are Converse tool calls served inside the runtime by agents/runtime/main.py; the allowlist module is unchanged..

info.title: Suggester finding reads
info.description: Three operations, each backed by an endpoint specs 002-004 already ship. Deliberately no list endpoint: this agent is invoked once per finding and has no reason to enumerate the others.

get.summary: Findings, filtered to the one being worked on.
get.description: Pass the finding's own id. The pass invokes this agent once per finding; reading the others spends budget that belongs to them.
